Name: Frame Galactia
Information:
**Arc Valinn**

Arc Valinn is a goddess of technology and considered the god of frame units and freedom. She was originally an astral elf exarch who helped to set exolunar frame unit technology on its path, then would ascend to godhood on her own in an effort to protect the universe from those who would hoard and abuse technology. Her physical form is split between two entities: her humanoid form, and her mechanical avatar Frame Galactia, a supermassive frame unit that can become an astradeck.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: Frame Galactia’s spellcasting ability is Charisma. They can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
traits.additional_text: When Frame Galactia casts any Astromancy spell with limited uses, it can spend one of its Legendary Actions for that round to cast it at 6th level, unless it was already higher, or three Legendary Actions to cast it at 9th. Frame Galactia does not make Eidomancy checks. Frame Galactia’s spells are cast as though they have a Footprint of 6 and their pilots were Medium sized, regardless of their actual size.

traits.name: Scale Shifter
traits.description: At the start of its turn, Frame Galactia may change its size to become any size between Gargantuan and Supermassive. If it makes itself Colossal or smaller, its melee reach is reduced by 20 feet, and its Macro trait doesn’t function. Regardless of its size, effects targeting it or restrictions based on size (such as damage being reduced for creatures of a certain size or lower) treat it as Supermassive.

traits.name: Universal Reactor (4/Rest)
traits.description: Frame Galactia can engage a powerful eidomantic core to use any of the following effects when they would apply. It cannot use the same effect more than once per turn. At the start of each of its turns, Frame Galactia rolls a d4: on a result of 4, it regains one spent use of its Universal Reactor.

options.name: Absolute Barrier
options.description: When it takes damage, Frame Galactia can take half damage instead, then half damage from all sources of damage until the end of that turn.

options.name: Cast Amplifier
options.description: On its turn, Frame Galactia casts one spell through Innate Spellcasting that has a limit of 2/Day or 3/Day, and if that spell requires 1 action it is cast as a bonus action.

options.name: Feat Drive
options.description: When Frame Galactia fails to hit with an attack, it can roll 2d6 and add the result to their failed attack roll, possibly changing the result. Then, until the end of that turn, they add the higher result from individual d6s to all of their attack rolls.

options.name: Hyperdrive Dash
options.description: Frame Galactia’s speed doubles until the end of its turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Frame Galactia makes three Grand Galaxium attacks.

actions.name: Grand Galaxium (Blade or Arcbow)
actions.description: Macro Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 40 ft., one target, or as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, range 500/1500 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) radiant damage plus 22 (4d10) force damage. [macro: 33 radiant plus 40 force].

actions.name: Eidomantic Fusion Arrow
actions.description: Frame Galactia fires an arrow of eidomantic energy as a 1000-foot long, 50-foot wide line originating from it. Each creature in that space must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (2d12 + 9) radiant damage plus 22 (4d10) force damage on a failure.

actions.name: Galactic Technobliteration (Recharge 6)
actions.description:
Frame Galactia fires a tremendous volley of explosives and energy into the air using Grand Galaxium, which splits into a maelstrom of individual bursts of light. Each target Frame Galactia chooses within 300 feet of a point it chooses within 3000 feet must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) fire damage and 55 (10d10) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

Alternatively, it can focus this energy on one creature it can see within 3000 feet, who must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw, taking 82 (15d10) fire damage and 82 (15d10) radiant damage on a failure.

options.name: Move
options.description: Frame Galactia moves up to its movement speed.

options.name: Attack
options.description: Frame Galactia makes a single Grand Galaxium attack.

options.name: Universal Recharge (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Frame Galactia regains one spent use of its Universal Reactor.
